description:
Get colocalisation results for a chromosome.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table colocalisation_coloc — one record = one COLOC colocalisation test between two credible sets.
Key: leftStudyLocusId, rightStudyLocusId.
Results: `_vbt.total` counts all matches.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. COLOC tests run by OT 25.09 between overlapping credible sets; absence means not tested.

min_score.description: Keeps rows with h4 >= this value; unknown values never pass. Defaults to 0.8; pass null for no restriction.
